title.narrative: Improving Democratic Governance and Electoral Processes in the State of Palestine - Phase II"

description.narrative: Improving Democratic Governance and Electoral Processes in the State of Palestine/Phase II (2026–2028) builds on UNDP/PAPP’s support since 2021 to strengthen democratic governance and inclusive electoral processes, while promoting democratic behavioural change across Palestinian society. Through partnerships with the Central Elections Commission (CEC) and a broad network of CSOs, academia, media, the Ministry of Education, unions, and the private sector, the project institutionalizes civic participation and accountability mechanisms (especially for women, youth, and persons with disabilities) and maintains flexible readiness to support local elections and pivot to Presidential and Parliamentary elections if called. The project delivers four outputs focusing on: (1) strengthening local electoral capacities and systems; (2) enhancing inclusive participation and representation; (3) reinforcing evidence-informed social accountability, transparency, and social cohesion; and (4) strengthening national readiness for general elections and related institutions.
